snippet.title: Scramble Knights Royale - Official Duos Playtest Trailer | The MIX | Kinda Funny Spring Showcase
snippet.description: Get a fresh look at gameplay from Scramble Knights Royale in this new trailer for the upcoming fantasy battle royale game. Embark on a classic top-down adventure together with friends. Fight monsters, complete quests, and conquer dungeons—all while brawling it out with 32 players in strategic and chaotic combat. Be the last knight standing to win! A Duos Playtest for Scramble Knights Royale runs on Steam from today, March 9, to March 12, 2026.
